text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew.
I had another great run today!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah... Is it about time to wrap up?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do a light stretch and wrap it up.
Yeah, let's finish up with some light stretching.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, please excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... They wrote "Do your best!"
They're actually...
thinking of me...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so happy~.
I've gotta reply right away♪
choice_data_list: What are you going to write?
What are you going to write?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's so much I want to write, I can't decide.
For now, I'll let them know I'm doing my best, and—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Would it be all right if we kept training...
just a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I want you to record me running. I'd love to send that video to my big sister.
choice_data_list: Didn't it say not to push yourself?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I must make good use of the time I've been given...
I'll focus even harder and do my best!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...It was written all over it.
Trainer, you really see right through me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll give up for today.
We can take a look at the video during our next training session.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Impatience and overexertion are forbidden, after all.
